summary: Both build lanes landed green and byte-stable. Era baseline rebuilt x2 under Rosetta x64 Node 12.14.1 (42 dist files, byte-identical to the a1 ingest build). Migrated lane reached a deterministic x2 Angular 16.2 browser-builder production build (39 dist files) after two truthful reds: the era karma/jasmine toolchain made the closure unresolvable, and @ngrx/effects' removed Effect decorator failed the build. Added two reusable analyzer-driven capabilities (target-cell testPackages alignment; @Effect()->createEffect migration, 11 tests), overfitting guard green. applicationFilesChanged grew 2->3. Parity recorded: 33 byte-identical payloads, zero orphans, ES5 differential-loading loss recorded as a difference. Deleted the superseded, non-reproducible m1 record. All four verify commands pass; 963 tests green.
